result.Method of Attack: Abuses Android Accessibility API to record device unlocking gestures and inject overlays into legitimate crypto wallet apps; Automatically modifies destination wallet address and amount to transfer cryptocurrency to attacker-controlled wallets; Uses Accessibility API to perform UI actions like clicking buttons without user intervention; Anti-analysis technique by malformatting APK resources to complicate automated analysis
result.Impacted Systems: Android users with mobile crypto wallet or banking applications
result.Attack Vector: Malicious Android application requesting Accessibility Service permissions
